prose.subject: Invoice INV-30525 - Thornbury Analytics
prose.body:
Dear Eastgate Clinics Team,

Please find attached invoice INV-30525 for services rendered during the current billing cycle. This invoice covers data processing and analytics support as outlined in our service agreement.

Line Items:
- Monthly Data Processing Fee: 1200.00 USDC
- Advanced Analytics Module: 500.00 USDC
- Priority Support Retainer: 343.01 USDC

Total Amount Due: 2043.01 USDC

Payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date. Please remit payment to our standard account: 0xac2b1ab6ebd80a26dc04f955933e7096485488fb.

If you have any questions regarding this invoice or require an itemized breakdown, please do not hesitate to contact our accounts receivable department at billing@thornbury-analytics.example.

Thank you for your continued partnership.

Best regards,

Thornbury Analytics
Billing Department
